title: A Sigil for the Veil
author: Beatrix Kavanagh
blurb: Cyrus Brightwater, a thief who steals memories, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
